item.body:
Closes #657
Claim: ext/francoisgn-readme

**Problem.** README of `dev-swift` had stale milestone figures (dated 2026-11-06, M4 "1 of 23", M5 "0 of 30"), stale phase counts (2026-11-01), no M5 content beyond a paragraph, an outdated "How it is built", and a contributing section missing steps (labels, session-id format, `REVIEW WANTED`, ledger, `/release`, PR limit). Support was at the bottom. The roadmap SVG showed M1–M4 only, with figures of 2026-10-29.

**Cause.** The milestone table is hand-written: nothing in `tooling/roadmap/` generates README (only the board comments), so no generator to fix. The SVG is generated from `docs/assets/source/roadmap/elements.json`.

**Changed (docs only, no macOS jobs).**
- `README.md`:
  - `> [!NOTE]` support block under the title: Leetchi link + existing Buy Me a Coffee badge; Apple Developer account $99 per year, image-hosting API $170 per year (operator precision), shared effort. `## Support` is now a short pointer.
  - "Where we are": no-public-build note (M1 lots done; LOT-161 #251, #344, #322 left); phase table without stale counts; milestone table with M1–M5 in one format plus a progress column.
  - "Big topics planned in M5": 7 grouped bullets linking the issues.
  - "How it is built" and "Contributing": rewritten as links to AGENTS.md, ORCHESTRATION, REVIEW-ROUNDS, CONTRIBUTING, EXTERNAL-AGENTS, MAC-SESSIONS. No rules copied; no CONTRIBUTING/EXTERNAL-AGENTS gap needed filling. The ledger rule follows #620 (kept as decided by the operator).
- Roadmap SVG (operator: change if needed): `elements.json` gets an M5 box and arrow from M4, the figures of the 2026-11-08 boards, and M4's text without the "iOS 27 experience" moved to M5; `roadmap-milestones.svg` and `.excalidraw` regenerated with the documented `export.js` (rendered and checked by eye); alt text in README and `docs/ROADMAP.md` mentions M5; the source README says M2–M5.

**Sources of numbers** (snapshot 2026-11-08): board body of #324 (M2 28/28 100 %, M3 38/43 88 %, M4 4/26 15 %, M5 0/29 0 %) and #166 (M1 40/40 100 %). M5 lots and scope notes: #324 M5 section and ezzz's comments of 2026-11-07/08 on #233, #234, #418, #421, #422, #242, #243, #244.

**Not done / to flag.**
- AGENTS.md §8 may still describe `changelog-legacy.d` fragments depending on the branch state; README follows #620 and only links it. Aligning AGENTS.md is #620's own PR.
- Stale board items reported on #324.

**Tests.** `npx markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1` on the changed `.md` files: 0 errors; `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py` OK. CodeRabbit: 2 rounds, 4 minor findings fixed, threads resolved.

Review wanted: Opus (author model: Sonnet 5.5).
